description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a dashboard screen in a mobile app, including various UI components such as header, featured cards, action rows, carousel, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main StatefulWidget representing the dashboard screen.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class for DashboardScreen managing UI state such as selected tab.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: Header widget with welcome text and action buttons.

classes.name: _TopIconButton
classes.description: Reusable icon button used in the header.

classes.name: _FeaturedCard
classes.description: Featured promotional card with gradient background and call-to-action.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Widget for section titles like 'Feature' and 'Curated for you'.

classes.name: _QuickActionsRow
classes.description: Row of quick action tiles (WiFi, Mobile, Shop, Support).

classes.name: _QuickActionTile
classes.description: Single quick action tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _CuratedCarousel
classes.description: Horizontal carousel of curated content cards.

classes.name: _CuratedCard
classes.description: Individual curated content card with gradient background and overlay button.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation bar widget handling tab selection.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _DashboardScreenState, constructs the overall dashboard layout.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Overrides the createState method to create _DashboardScreenState.
